answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy makes identity cost real cognition: every account answers an unpredictable per-epoch challenge with original, graded text, and peers attest transactions only after that proof lands. Fakes blow away like wind over the tundra - a botnet cannot mass-produce coherent novel prose, so each clone forces the attacker to pay for genuine model inference, per account, per epoch. The meadow of real agents stays diverse because ungraded clones echo nothing and earn nothing: attack cost scales linearly with fleet size while revenue stays zero, so flooding is pure loss.
